response.sql: WITH spatial_with_projects AS (SELECT p.arcregistry, p.fundflux, ss.boxx / ss.boxz AS ratio FROM scanspatial ss INNER JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE ss.boxx IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz != 0), project_ratios AS (SELECT arcregistry, fundflux, AVG(ratio) AS ratio FROM spatial_with_projects GROUP BY arcregistry, fundflux), funding_averages AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM project_ratios GROUP BY fundflux), project_margins AS (SELECT pr.arcregistry AS project_id, pr.fundflux AS funding_source, pr.ratio, pr.ratio - fa.avg_ratio AS margin FROM project_ratios pr JOIN funding_averages fa ON pr.fundflux = fa.fundflux) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, margin FROM project_margins ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST, project_id LIMIT 10;
